sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सफलः कृष्ण संकल्पः सिद्धिश्च नियता मम। यस्य मे त्वं हृषीकेश यथेप्सितमुपस्थितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Krishna, O Hrishikesha, when you have come here agreeably to my wish, my resolve is fulfilled; success is sure to come to my work.

sa: न हया न रथो वीर न यन्ता मम दारुकः। अदृश्यन्त शरैश्छन्नास्तथाहं सैनिकाश्च मे॥
en: O nero, I could not at that time see either my car or horses or my charioteer Daruka. For ! and my soldiers were covered with arrows.

sa: धनं च बहु तद् दीक्षाप गोविन्द त्वमात्मानं महाभुजा त्वयीष्टवति दाशार्ह विपाप्मा भविता ह्यहम्॥
en: O Govinda, O long-armed hero, O prince of the Dasarha race, install yourself in that sacrifice. If you perform the sacrifice, I shall be cleansed from sin.

sa: किं नु मे नाग्नयः शूद्र प्रतिनन्दन्ति दर्शनम्। त्वं चापि न यथापूर्वं कच्चित् क्षेममिहाश्रमे॥
en: "O Shudra, why does not the fire delight on seeing me? You too do not express delight as you always do? Is everything well in the hermitage?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच क्षत्ता मन्त्री महाप्राज्ञः स्थितो यस्यास्मि शासने। तेन संगम्य वेत्स्यामि कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra says I always follow the counsel of greatly intelligent Khattwa (Vidura), my minister. Having consulted with him, I shall inform you my decision (in this matter).

sa: विवदन्तौ तथा तौ तु मुनीनां दर्शने स्थितौ। ये तस्य यज्ञे संवृत्तास्तेऽपृच्छन्त कथं त्विमौ॥
en: Markandeya continued When they were thus quarreling before the Munis who were engaged in the sacrifice, the latter enquired "What is the matter with these two men?

sa: ह्रस्वौष्ठं ताम्रजिह्वास्यं रक्तकणं चलद्धृवम्। विवृत्तदंष्ट्रादशनं शुक्लतीक्ष्णाग्रशोभितम्॥ अपश्यद् वदनं तस्य रश्मिवन्तमिवोडुपम्। वदनाभ्यन्तरगतैः शुक्लैर्दन्तैरलंकृतम्॥
en: He (Bhima) saw Hanumana's head furnished with small lips, coppery face, long tongue, red ears, brisk eyes and bare white teeth sharpened at the edge.

sa: न तं देशं प्रपश्यामि यत्र सोऽस्मान् सुदुर्जनः। न विज्ञास्यति दुष्टात्मा चारैरिति सुयोधनः॥
en: I do not find a country where, if we live, that wicked and evil-natured Suyodhana will not be able to discover us by his spies.

sa: शास्त्रं न शास्ति दुर्बुद्धिं श्रेयसे चेतराय च। न वै वृद्धो बालमतिर्भवेद् ग़जन् कथंचन॥
en: The Shastras can never control the wickedminded men, either in good or in evil acts. A man of boyish intelligence can never act as an old man.

sa: धार्मिक्श्चापि भवति मोक्षं च लभते परम्। तपो निःश्रेयसं जन्तोस्तस्य मूलं शमो दमः॥
en: He thus becomes virtucus and he thus finally attains salvation. Tara (meditation) is the chief requisite for obtaining salvation, resignation and forbearance are its roots.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क एष भगवन् दैत्यो महावीर्यस्तपोधन॥ कस्य पुत्रोऽथ नप्ता वा एतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्।
en: Yudhishthira said: O exalted one, O great ascetic, who was this greatly powerful Daitya? Whose son and whose grandson was he? I desire to know all this.

sa: भीष्म उवाच उक्तवानस्मि कल्याणि धर्मस्य परमा गतिः। लोके न शक्यते ज्ञातुमपि विज्ञैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Bhisma said O blessed lady, I have said the course of Dharma is subtle. Even the illustrious wise men cannot understand it in the world.

sa: सनाथाः पाण्डवाः सर्वे त्वया नाथेन वीर्यवन्। तवैव तेजसा सर्वान् विजेष्यामो वयं परान्॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, when you have become our protector, the Pandavas have (already) secured their lord. With your effulgence we shall conquer all our enemies."

sa: भीम उवाच भवन्ति गेहे बन्धक्यः कितवानां युधिष्ठिर। न ताभिरुत दीव्यन्ति दया चैवास्ति तास्वपि॥
en: Bhima said O Yudhisthira, the gamblers have in their house many loose women. They do not play staking even those women. They have kindness even towards them.

sa: तथा ब्रुवति वायौ तु पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह। देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्ववौ च पवनः शिवः॥
en: While the wind-god was thus speaking, there was a downfall of floral showers; as also the divine kettle-drum played and auspicious breezes began to blow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तत्र भ्रातृभिश्चैव कृष्णाया चैव पाण्डवः। स्नात्वा देवान् पितॄश्चैव तर्पयामास भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, the Pandava (Yudhishthira) bathed there with his brothers and Krishna (Draupadi) and offered oblations to the Pitris and the celestials.

sa: तस्य संवत्सरे पूर्णे पाश एकः प्रमुच्यते। तस्मात् सत्यं तु वक्तव्यं जानता सत्यमञ्जसा॥
en: On the completion of one full year, one such Pasha is loosened (from his body). Therefore, he, who knows, should speak the truth without concealment.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मार्कण्डेयमृषयो ब्राह्मणा युधिष्ठिश्च पर्यपृच्छन्नृषिः केन दीर्घायुरासीद् बको मार्कण्डेयस्तु तान् सर्वानुवाच॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The Rishis, the Brahmanas and Yudhishthira then asked Markandeya how the Rishi Baka was (so) long-lived. Markandeya thus spoke to them all.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथंवीर्यः स राजाभूत् सोमको वदतां वर। कर्माण्यस्य प्रभावं च श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O foremost of speakers, what was the prowess of the king, Somaka. I desire to hear an exact account of his achievements and prowess.

sa: वायुर्नित्यं ववौ तत्र नित्यं देवश्च वर्षति। स्वाध्यायघोषश्च तथा श्रूयते न च दृश्यते॥
en: The wind always blew there and the celestials always poured showers. The sounds of the recitation of sacred scripture were heard, but none was seen.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः युधिष्ठिर यमौ भीम मनसा कुरुतार्जवम्। मनसा कृतशौचा वै शुद्धास्तीर्थानि यास्यथ॥
en: "O Yudhishthira, O the twins, O Bhima, banish all evil thoughts from your minds. Purify your hearts and thus being purified go to the Tirthas.

sa: ते वयं पाण्डवधनैः सर्वान् सम्पूज्य पार्थिवान्। यदि तान् योधयिष्यामः किं वै नः परिहास्यति॥
en: If we gratify with the wealth of his Pandavas, the kings of the world and then fight with the sons of Pandu, what reverse can overtake us?

sa: तेषां भीमो महाबाहुः स संनिमन्त्रयामास महीपालान् विशाम्पतिः। एषोऽनुभूयतां वीरा: स्वयंवर इति प्रभो॥
en: O exalted one, the king united all the rulers of the earth saying, “O heroes, the Svayamvara ceremony of Damayanti is going to be held.”

sa: न तु शक्या: क्षयं नेतुं समुद्राश्रयगा हि ते। समुद्रस्य क्षये बुद्धिर्भवद्भिः सम्प्रधार्यताम्॥
en: But they cannot be killed, as they have taken shelter under the sea. You should therefore find out some means to dry up the ocean.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अप्रमादेन सुहृदामन्येषां च महात्मनाम्। यदि शक्या विजेतुं ते तन्ममाचक्ष्व मातुल॥
en: Duryodhana said O uncle, without any danger to our friends and other illustrious men, if there is means to conquer him, tell it to me.

sa: लोमश उवाच तत: स याजयामास सोमकं तेन जन्तुना। मातरस्तु बलात् पुत्रमपाकर्षः कृपान्विताः॥
en: Lomasha said: Thereupon he performed that sacrifice in which Jantu was offered as a victim. But the mothers out of affection forcibly dragged the son.

sa: इहस्थैरेव तत् सर्वं श्रोतव्यं भरतर्षभाः। न कार्या वः कथंचित् स्यात् तत्राभिगमने मतिः॥
en: O most exalted of the Bharatas all these are heard even from this place. Do you by no means, have a mind to go thither.

sa: एतेषु विजितेष्वद्य भविष्यति मही मम। सर्वे च पृथिवीपालाः सभा सा च महाधना॥
en: If I can conquer them, the whole world will be mine; as also the kings and the Assembly hall which is so full of wealth.

sa: पर्वतेषु च रम्येषु सर्वेषु च सरस्सु च। उदधौ च महापुण्ये सूपस्पृष्टं महात्मभिः॥
en: We have with the high-souled Rishis performed our ablutions in all the sacred and beautiful mountains and lakes and also in the highly holy sea.

sa: तेषामहं संनिधौ त्वां वरयिष्यामि नैषध। एवं तव महाबाहो दोषो न भवितेति ह॥
en: O king of Nishadhas, I will choose you among those celestials. O you mighty-armed warrior, if this be done, no blame will surely touch you.

sa: तत एषां वधार्थाय शक्रोऽस्त्राणि ददौ तव। न हि शक्याः सुरैर्हन्तुं य एते निहतास्त्वया॥
en: Therefore, Shakra gave you the weapons for the destruction of these (demons). Even the gods had been unable to slay these that have been killed by you.

sa: मम ज्ञातिषु निक्षिप्य दारको स्यन्दनं तथा। अश्वांश्चमान् यथाकामं वस वान्यत्र गच्छ वा॥
en: Leaving the children and the car and these horses with my relatives, do you go there or go away wherever it pleases you to go,'

sa: अनुप्रश्नः संशयो वा नैतत् त्वय्युपपद्यते। तथा छुपेता बुद्ध्या त्वं कृष्णस्य महिषी प्रिया॥
en: It does not become you to put further questions to me or to doubt me. You are intelligent, you are the favourite wife of Krishna.

sa: अपां नारा इति पुरा संज्ञाकर्म कृतं मया। तेन नारायणोऽप्युक्तो मम तत् त्वयनं सदा॥
en: In days of yore, I called the waters by the name of Nara and because the waters have ever been my Ayana (abode), I am called Narayana.

sa: कृष्णोवाच यत् ते कुन्ती महाबाहो जातस्यैच्छद्धनंजय॥ तत् तेऽस्तु सर्वं कौन्तेय यथा च स्वयमिच्छसि।
en: Draupadi said : O mighty-armed Dhananjaya, O son of Kunti, let all that Kunti desired at your birth and all that you yourself (always) desire be accomplished.

sa: कालेन महता वेदाः : शक्या गुरुमुखाद् विभो। प्राप्तुं तस्मादयं यत्नः परमो मे समास्थितः॥
en: O lord, the knowledge of the Vedas that are to be learnt from teachers, requires long time to acquire. Therefore I am engaged in this great attempt.

sa: तथाभूते तु भगवान् नावधीन्महिषं रणे। सस्मार च तदा स्कन्दं मृत्यु तस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: Though the exalted Rudra was in this plight, he did not kill Mahisha, for he knew that the wicked wretch would be killed by Skanda.

sa: धर्मतः पाण्डुपुत्रा वै वनं गच्छन्ति निर्जिताः। ते च द्वादश वर्षाणि वने वत्स्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: The sons of Pandu, being defeated at dice, are going to the forest to save their virtue. The Pandavas will live for twelve years in the forest.

sa: यथा गुप्तस्त्वया राजा चरेत् तीर्थानि सत्तम। दानं दद्याद् यथा चैव तथा कुरु महामुने॥
en: O excellent man, O great Rishi, let the king, protected by you, visit the various sacred shrines and give away (much wealth) to the Brahmanas in charity."

sa: स सर्वविद् द्रौपदी वीक्ष्य कृष्णां युधिष्ठिरं भीमसेनार्जुनौ च। संस्मृत्य रामं मनसा महात्मा तपस्विमध्येऽस्मयतामितौजाः॥
en: Seeing Draupadi, Yudhishthira, Bhima and Arjuna in the midst of the ascetics, that illustrious and omniscient ascetic of incomparable prowess, smiled thinking of Rama in his mind.

sa: नारद उवाच आवयोः कुशलं देव सर्वत्रगतमीश्वर। लोके च मघवन् कृत्स्ने नृपाः कुशलिनो विभो॥
en: Narada said: O Lord, O God, we enjoy peace as regards all matters; and O Maghavat, O illustrious one, so also the beings of the entire world.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वनं गतेषु पार्थेषु निर्जितेषु दुरोदरे। धृतराष्ट्र महाराज तदा चिन्ता समाविशत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said At the departure of the Pandavas to the forest after being defeated at dice, the great king Dhritarashtra was afflicted with great anxiety.

sa: स वै विवदनाद् भीत: सुधन्वानं विलोकयन्। तं सुधन्वाब्रवीत् क्रुद्धो ब्रह्मदण्ड इव ज्वलन्॥
en: He (Prahlada), being alarmed at their quarrel, looked at Sudhanva. (Thereupon) Sudhanva thus spoke to him burning in rage as the Brahmadanda (club of Brahma).

sa: शकुनिरुवाच यां त्वमेतां श्रियं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे। तप्यसे तां हरिष्यामि द्यूतेन जयतां वर॥
en: Shakuni said O foremost of all virtuous men, I shall win by dice the prosperity of the son of Pandu, Yudhishthira, seeing which you so much grieve.

sa: कुशली ते पिता राज्ञि जननी भ्रातरश्च ते। आयुष्मन्तौ कुशलिनौ तत्रस्थौ दारकौ च तौ॥
en: O princess! your father is at peace, as also your mother and brothers. Those, your son and daughter, are enjoying length of days and living in peace.

sa: न ह्यस्य निन्दितं जिष्णोः सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षये। चरितं तस्य शूरस्य तन्मे सर्वं प्रकीर्तय॥
en: I do not find the most trivial thing in Jishnu (Arjuna) which might be called censurable. (Therefore) narrate the history of that hero to me.

sa: ग्लहं च सैन्धवं राजंस्तत्र द्युतस्य निश्चयः॥ सैन्धवे तु महद् द्यूतं समासक्तं परैः सह।
en: In this game of dice, know the ruler of the Sindhus to be the stake. Indeed Jayadratha is the precious stake for which we are fighting today.

sa: एतेषु हि मृतेष्वद्य ये त्वया परिकीर्तिताः। येऽपि जीवन्ति ते सर्वे मृता इति मतिर्मम॥
en: The names of those, who are slain today, had been described by you. But my opinion is that those who are still alive are now perhaps dead.

sa: पश्य पार्थ धनुः श्रेष्ठ विकर्षन् साधु शोभते। शत्रु जित्वा यथा शक्रो देवसंघैः समावृतः॥
en: See Partha, how beautiful he looks while drawing his best of bows as did shine Shakra in the midst of the celestials after having defeated his enemies.

sa: अभिद्रवत भद्रं वो दुतं द्रवत कौरवाः। यथा जीवन वः कश्चिन्मुच्येत युधि सृञ्जयः॥
en: “May you fare well, O Kauravas. Do you move on with such a force that no Srinjaya can escape from the battle-field with his life.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सुदुष्करमिदं कर्म कृतं भीमेन संजय। येन कर्णो महाबाहू रथोपस्थे निपातितः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Highly difficult was this feat performed by Bhima, O Sanjaya, by which the mighty-armed Karna was caused to lie down on his car.

sa: सौबलं च तदा तात नीतिमानिति मन्यते॥ कर्णश्च रभसो नित्यं राजा तं चाप्यनुव्रतः।
en: O Sire, the son of Subala was considered to be possessed of great policy; as also Karna was always extremely attached to the prince (Duryodhana).

sa: अजेयाः पाण्डवास्तात देवैरपि सवासवैः। न च तद् बुध्यते मन्दः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम॥
en: The Pandavas are incapable of being vanquished even by the celestials led by Vasava himself. But my Duryodhana will not take cognisance of this fact.

sa: युद्धे हि निहतः शूरो विसृजन् सायकान् बहून्॥ को हि मे जीवितेनार्थस्तमृते पुरुषर्षभम्।
en: While that hero was showering forth innumerable arrows, he was slain in battle. Without that foremost of persons what necessity have I for my life."

sa: न तं पश्यामि लोकेऽस्मिस्त्वत्तो ह्यन्यं धनुर्धरम्। अर्जुनं समरे क्रुद्धं यो वेलामिव धारयेत्॥
en: As a continent resists the fury of the surging sea, so you are the only archer in all the world who can resist Dhananjaya's rage.

sa: धनुषा स्पृष्टमात्रेण व्यायुधं नावधीच्चैनं कर्णः कुन्त्या वचः स्मरन्। धनुषोऽग्रेण तं कर्ण सोऽभिद्रुत्य परामृशत्॥
en: Recollecting the words of Kunti, Karna then did not slay Bhima who was then weaponless but with the handle of his bow he poked and pierced him.

sa: सर्वथा परिहीनाः स्म तेजसा च बलेन च। भवता पाल्यमानास्ते विवर्धन्ते पुनः पुनः॥
en: We, on the other hand, are becoming reduced in mighty and in energy, while the Pandavas, spared by you, are again and again gaining strength.

sa: सिषिचुः शरधाराभिः पाकशासनिमाहवे॥ संछाद्यमानः कौन्तेयः शरजालैरनेकशः। अक्रुध्यत् स महाबाहुरजितः कुरुनन्दनः॥ ततः शरमयं जालं तुमुलं पाकशासनिः। व्यसृजत् पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तव सैन्यजिघांसया॥ ते हन्यमाना वीरेण योधा राजन् रणे तव।
en: Began to pour their arrowy showers of Pakasasani in that battle. Then that delight of was over. the Kurus (Arjuna) covered Thereafter, that foremost of men, Pakasasani began to shoot terrible net-works of arrows with a view to slaughter your troops. Then those warriors of yours mangled by that hero in battle.

sa: पुनः पुनर्न मृष्यामि हतं कर्णं च पाण्डवैः। यस्य बाह्वोर्बलं तुल्यं कुञ्जराणां शतं शतैः॥
en: Again and again, I cannot bear that Karna should be slain by the Pandavas; for whose strength of arms is equal to that of ten thousand elephants.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अर्जुने सैन्धवं प्राप्ते भारद्वाजेन संवृताः। पञ्चाला; कुरुभिः सार्धं किमकुर्वत संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When Arjuna had got the Sindhu king within reach, witat, O Sanjaya, did the Panchalas, assailed by Bharadvaja's son, do, encountering the Kurus?

sa: प्रयातौ तत्र राजेन्द्र यत्र शल्यो व्यवस्थितः। तौ तु प्रत्युद्ययौ राजन् राक्षसेन्द्रो ह्यलम्बुषः॥
en: Came to that spot, O king of kings, where Shalya was. Against them both, O king, advanced Alambusha, the lord of the Rakshasas. wide open

sa: षष्ठेन तु ध्वज राज्ञः सप्तमेन त कार्मुकम्। अष्टभेन तथा खङ्गं पातयामास भूतले॥
en: Thereafter he smote down the king's standard with the sixth arrows, his bow with the seventh and his sword with the eighth, upon the ground.

sa: गुरुपुत्र इति ह्येनं मानयन् भरतर्षभ। उपेक्षा कुरु मा पार्थ नायं काल उपेक्षितुम्॥
en: O glory of Bharata's race, esteeming your assailant as the son of your preceptor stop not, O Partha, this is not the time for forbearance.

sa: पञ्च नद्यो वहन्त्येता यत्र निःसृत्य पर्वतात्॥ आरट्टा नाम दीका न तेष्वार्योद्वयहं वसेत्।
en: No respectable man should live even for two days where the five rivers flow just after issuing from the mountains and where live Aratta Balhikas.

sa: अन्यस्मै देहि गाण्डीवमिति मां योऽभिचोदयेत्॥ भिन्द्यामहं तस्य शिर इत्युपांशुव्रत मम। तदुक्तं मम चानेन राज्ञामितपराक्रम॥ समक्षं तव गोविन्द न तत् क्षन्तुमिहोत्सहे। तस्मादेनं वधिष्यामि राजानं धर्मभीरुकम्॥
en: He who tells me-'Give your Gandiva to another,' I would cut his head off, such is my secret vow. Now that this king of immeasurable prowess has told me those words in your presence, O Govinda, I won't forgive him. I will, therefore, put to the sword this pious king.

sa: सा किमर्थं तु कर्णेन प्रवृत्ते समरे पुरा। न देवकीसुते मुक्ता फाल्गुने वापि संजय॥
en: Why then, O Sanjaya, was it not hurled by Karna at the son of Devaki or at Phalguna while he was engaged with these in battle before.

sa: सीदेत समरे जिष्णो नात्र कार्या विचारणा। न तं पश्यामि लोकेषु चिन्तयन् पुरुषं क्वचित्॥
en: In battle, would be quite stupefied. O Jishnu, there is no doubt of this. Even on reflection, I do not find any individual in the (three) words.

sa: तद्वधाय नरश्रेष्ठ स्मरैतद् वचनं मम। यथा भवति तत् सत्यं तथा कुरु धनंजय॥
en: Remember, O best of men, my words and fulfill them (i.e., the vows). O Dhananjaya, act in such a way that they may prove true.”

sa: अभियाति द्रुतं कर्णं तद् वारय महास्थम्। वृतः सैन्येन महता याहि यत्र महाबलः॥
en: Rush against that mighty car-warrior, Do you check the Rakshasa's progress; supported by mighty divisions do you go to the spot where the highly powerful.

sa: निर्जित्य हि रणे पार्थः सर्वान् मम महारथान्। अवधीत् सैन्धवं संख्ये न च कश्चिदवारयत्॥
en: (And Suyodhana, thought within himself.) No was able to resist him when having defeated all the great car-warriors on my side, Partha slew the king of Sindhus.

sa: प्राणिनामवधस्तात सर्वज्यायान् मतो मम। अनृतां वा वदेद् वाचं न तु हिंस्यात् कथञ्चन॥
en: Methinks, keeping from doing any injury to any animal is a cardinal virtue. Even an untruth might behold but never an animal ought be slain.

sa: न तत्रासीदधर्मिष्ठमशस्तं युद्धमेव च। नात्र कर्णी न नालीको न लिप्तो न च बस्तिकः॥
en: In that battle there was nothing unfair or nothing against the rules of military science. In that battle, neither Kanies nor Nalikas, nor poisoned arrows nor Vastikas.

sa: स तत्र गच्छ कौन्तेय यत्र यातो धनंजयः॥ सात्यकिश्च महावीर्यः कर्तव्यं यदि मन्यसे।
en: O son of Kunti! do you hie yourself to the spot where Dhananjaya and Satyaki of great energy, have gone! This indeed is your duty.

sa: न तथा गच्छति रथस्तयनस्य विशाम्पते। नेन्द्रस्य न तु रुद्रस्य नापि वैश्रवणस्य च॥
en: O ruler of men, even the chariot of the sun himself or of Indra or of Rudra or of Vaishravana, can never proceed so quickly.

sa: एतदर्थं हि हैडिम्बे पुत्रानिच्छन्ति मानवाः। कथं नस्तारयेद् दुःखात् स त्वं तारय बान्धवान्॥
en: It is for saving them from difficulties, that men desire to have sons; O son of Hidimba, do you therefore, rescue your fathers and friends.

sa: सारङ्ग इव धर्मातः काम विलप शुष्य च॥ नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यं क्षत्रवृत्ते व्यवस्थितः।
en: Like a deer perspiring, you may either bewail or pant; observant of the duties of a Kshatriya I am incapable of being frightened by you.

sa: राजा भवत्वद्य सुनिर्वृतोऽयं कर्णं रणे नाशयितासि बाणैः। इत्येवमुक्त्वा पुनराह पार्थो युधिष्ठिरं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम्॥
en: Today a king Yudhishthira will be pleased. I shall distroyed Karna by my arrows. Thus addressing Arjuna, again said to Yudhishthira, the foremost of man of duties.

sa: समीक्ष्य तदवस्थं तं वधायास्य मनो दधे। वेगं चक्रे महान्तं च राक्षसेन्द्ररथं प्रति॥
en: Beholding him in that state, resolved to slay him. Then he rushed with great vehemence upon the car of that foremost of the Rakshasas (Alambusha).

sa: द्रोण उवाच दुर्योधन किमेवं मां वाक्शरैरपि कृन्तसि। अजय्यं सततं संख्ये ब्रुवाणं सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: Drona said O Duryodhana, why are you piercing me with words (keen) as darts? I have told you (repeatedly) that Savyasachi is uncognizable in battle.

sa: अद्य धर्मसुतो राजा श्रुत्वा त्वां निहतं मया। सवीडो भविता सद्यो येनासीह प्रवेशितः॥
en: Today Dharma's son king Yudhishthira hearing you slain by me, would be covered with shame, for it was he who dispatched you on this mission.

sa: तस्य द्रोणो धनुर्मध्ये क्षुरप्रेण शितेन च। चकर्त गार्धपत्रेण यतमानस्य शुष्मिणः॥ तस्य तद्
en: Then Drona, with a sharp razor-faced arrow winged with feathers of vultures. cut-off in the middle, the bow of that mighty warrior striving in battle.

sa: उभौहि शूरौ बलिनौ दृढायुधौ महारथौ संहननोपपन्नौ। एतादृशौ फाल्गुनवासुदेवौ कोऽन्यः प्रतीयान्मदृते तौ तु शल्य॥
en: Who but myself, O Shalya, would dare face this Phalguna and Vasudeva in battle, for both of them are athletic, firm-handed, skillful in war and mighty car-warriors.

sa: एतावदुक्तवा वचनं प्रहष्टो ननाद चोचै रुधिराईगात्रः। ननर्द चैवातिबलो महात्मा वृत्रं निहत्येव सहस्रनेत्रः॥
en: And the mighty Bhimasena uttering these joyfully with blood streaming through his body, began to shout loudly as thousand-eyes (Indra) after killing the (Asura) Vritra.

sa: एकत्रिंशन्महाराज पुत्रांस्तव निपातितान्। हतान् दुर्योधनो दृष्ट्वा क्षत्तुः सस्मार तद् वचः॥ तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं क्षत्तुनिःश्रेयसं वचः। इति संचिन्त्य ते पुत्रो नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत॥ दुर्बुद्धिरब्रवीत् तनयस्तव। सभामानाय्य पाञ्चाली कर्णेन सहितोऽल्पधीः॥ यच्च कर्णोऽब्रवीत् कृष्णां सभायां परुषं वचः। प्रमुख पाण्डुपुत्राणां तव चैव विशाम्पते॥
en: Thinking thus, king Duryodhana was unable to do what he should do. All those words that your wicked-minded and foolish son, urged on by Karna, said to that princess of the Panchala race, having brought her in the assembly shall; also all those harsh words which Karna himself addressed in the assembly hall to her before yourself and the sons of Pandu, O monarch, at your and the Kauravas' hearing words to this effect, 'O Krishna, the

sa: यावत् पार्थो न जानाति सात्यकि बहुभिर्वृतम्। ते त्वरध्वं तथा शूराः शराणां मोक्षणे भृशम्॥
en: Let now a detachment of mighty and foremost car-warriors intercept Pritha's son, so that he may not advance to the rescue of Satyaki now surrounded by many.

sa: वनस्पतीनां पतये नराणां पतये नमः। गवां च पतये नित्यं यज्ञानां पतये नमः॥
en: You are nourisher to vegetation and king to human-beings. You are the defender of cows and governor to all offerings (yajna). Frequent salute to you.

sa: गजान् स्थान् समारुह्य व्युदस्य च हयाञ्जनाः। प्राद्रवन् सर्वतः संख्ये दृष्ट्वा रुक्मरथं हतम्॥
en: Beholding him of the golden car slain, men began to fly on all sides, riding on their elephants and cars and urging on their steeds.

sa: तस्य तान् निघ्नतः शत्रून् रुक्मपृष्ठं महद् धनुः॥ भल्लाभ्यां पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठसिधा चिच्छेद मारिष।
en: Revered king! Yudhishthira, the eldest Pandava splitted the huge bow, gold studded with Duryodhana up into three pieces by giving acute blows twice with Bhalla.

sa: यथा हि शिशिरापाये दहेत् कक्षं हुताशनः। तथा तदस्रं पाण्डूनां ददाह ध्वजिनीं प्रभो॥
en: O lord, as fire consumes a heap of dry grass in summer, even so did that weapon begin to consume the army of the Pandavas.

sa: स त्वां पृच्छामि कौन्तेय यथाद्य कुशलं तथा। तन्ममाचक्ष्व कात्स्नर्येन यथा कर्णो हतस्त्वया॥
en: Therefore it is that I ask you today, O son of Kunti, about your welfare. Relate to me in detail how you slew Karna today.

sa: यः सर्वतः पर्यपतत्त्वदर्थे सदार्चितो गर्वितः सूतपुत्रः। स शूरमानी समरे समेत्य कचित्त्वया निहतः संयुगेऽसौ॥
en: How did you encounter and kill in battle that well-honored hero, that proud and haughty son of Suta who used to search you everywhere in the battle-field.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अश्वत्थामन् प्रसीदस्व क्षन्तुमर्हसि मानद। कोपः खलु न कर्तव्यः सूतपुत्रं कथंचन॥
en: Duryodhana said O Ashvatthama, O bestower of honours, be gratified; do forgive (him). O siniess one, you should not be angry with the charioteer's son.

sa: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद् वा हिमवान् वा हिमं त्यजेत्। अतीयात् सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितुः॥
en: Even if beauty forsake the moon, or Himavat his snow, or the ocean overleaps its shores, I shall not forsake the promise of my sire.

sa: राम दाशरथे वीर वीर्यं ते श्रूयतेऽद्भुतम्। धनुषो भेदनं चैव निखिलेन मया श्रुतम्॥
en: Rama, son of Dasaratha, I have, O hero, heard of your wonderful prowess; and I have also heard all about your breaking of the bow.

sa: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह। किं मे धर्माद् विहीनस्य राजधर्मः करिष्यति॥
en: Hearing Rāma's words, Bharata answered, Deprived of the kingdom in consequence of my posteriority in point of birth, what does regard for morality avail me?

sa: न देवलोकाक्रमणं नामरत्वमहं वृणे। ऐश्वर्यं चापि लोकानां कामये न त्वया विना ॥
en: Alienated from you I do not long for the abode of the celestials, nor for eternal life, nor for the wealth of the three regions.

sa: कथं नु तस्य वैदेहीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा। इच्छसे प्रसभं हर्तुं प्रभामिव विवस्वतः॥
en: How does you then wish to carry away by force his Vaidehī, protected by virtue of her own chastity, like to the rays of Sun?

sa: अज्ञानाद्धि कृतं यस्मादिदं ते तेन जीवसे। अपि ह्यकुशलं न स्याद् राघवाणां कुतोभवान् ॥
en: It is because you have done this through ignorance that you (still) live, else the race itself of the Rāghavas should be not, and where are you?

sa: रामप्रसादात् कीर्तिं च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। प्राप्तवानिह सुग्रीवो रुमां मां च परंतप॥
en: O afflictor of foes, through Rāma's grace, Sugriva has here attained fame and the enduring empire of the monkeys, as well as Umā and myself.

sa: गङ्गायाः पतनं राजन् पृथिवी न सहिष्यते। तां वै धारयितुं राजन् नान्यं पश्यामि शूलिनः॥
en: For Gangā's fall, O king, Earth will not be able to sustain. And to hold her, O king find I none save the wielder of the Trident.'

sa: एते ते शैलराजस्य सुते लोकनमस्कृते। गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा उमादेवी च राघव॥
en: And these, O Rāghava, are the daughters of that king of mountains, worshipped of all, viz, Gangā, the foremost of streams, and the divine Uma.

sa: सा हि देवी महाराज कैकेयी राज्यकारणात्। अपि न च्यावयेत् प्राणान् दृष्ट्वा भरतमागतम्॥
en: Will not that revered lady, for the purpose of having Bharata established in the kingdom, take the king's life, when she shall see Bharata arrived?

sa: स नास्ति परमित्येतत् कुरु बुद्धिं महामते। प्रत्यक्षं यत् तदातिष्ठ परोक्षं पृष्ठतः कुरु॥
en: O magnanimous one, assure yourself there is no hereafter. Do you remain grounded in the evident, turning your back on what is beyond our ken.

sa: हा राम रामानुज हा हा वैदेहि तपस्विनि। न मां जानीत दुःखेन म्रियमाणमनाथवत्॥
en: Ah Rāma! Ah you younger brother of Rāma! Ah you unfortunate Vaidehī! You do not know that I am through grief lamenting like one deserted.

sa: न त्वां त्यजामि शबले नापि मेऽपकृतं त्वया। एष त्वां नयते राजा बलान्मत्तो महाबलः॥
en: O Śabala, not that I forsake you; nor hast you done me any wrong. But this mighty king proud of his prowess has been carrying you away.

sa: पद्मानना पद्मपलाशनेत्रा पद्मानि वाऽऽनेतुमभिप्रयाता। तदप्ययुक्तं नहि सा कदाचिन् मया विना गच्छति पङ्कजानि॥
en: Or has Janaki having eyes resembling lotuspetals has gone to bring lotuses? But how is that possible, she never goes without me to bring lotuses.

sa: तत्र त्वं वस हे सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह। न स्मरिष्यसि नारीणां मानुषीणां मनस्विनि॥
en: O Sītā, O you the daughter of a king, in this city shall you dwell with me. O large-minded damsel, you shall never think of earthly women.

sa: विशल्यं कुरु मां राजन् मर्म मे निशितः शरः॥ रुणद्धि मृदु सोत्सेधं तीरमम्बुरयो यथा।
en: Do you (now), O king, take out the arrow. Your sharpened shaft afflicts my marrow, like the tide of a river wearing away a hollowheaving sand bank.

sa: तं चतुर्भि खरः क्रुद्धो रामं गात्रेषु मार्गणैः। विव्याध हृदि मर्मज्ञौ मातङ्गमिव तोयरैः॥
en: And thereat Khara, understanding the import of things, fired with wrath, pierced Rāma's breast with five arrows, like one striking an elephant with a goad.

sa: किष्किन्धां ह्यद्य शून्या च स्वर्गते वानरेश्वरे। उद्यानानि च शून्यानि पर्वताः काननानि च॥
en: On that monkey chief's departure to the land of celestials, Kişkindhā was divested of her lord, and gardens, hills and woods were all rendered lonely.

sa: नहि मे काशितं राज्यं सुखमात्मनि वा प्रियम्। यथानिदेशं कर्तुं वै तवैव रघुनन्दन ॥
en: Mine is not the desire to obtain the kingdom for enjoying happiness or attaining any benefit. I will, O descendant of the Raghu race, do your bidding.

sa: अर्घ्यं च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतः सुसमाहितः। वने प्रसादं विप्रेन्द्रान्मा विप्रं मन्युराविशेत् ॥
en: He offered him Arghya in due form, and with a collected mind; and asked for his favour, so that wrath could not influence the Vipra.

sa: रुमां तु वीरः परिरभ्य गाढं वरासनस्थो वरहेमवर्णः। ददर्श सौमित्रिमदीनसत्त्वं विशालनेत्रः स विशालनेत्रम्॥
en: Then deeply embracing Umā, the large-eyed hero of the hue of fine gold, seated on an excellent seat, saw the powerful Saumitri having expansive eyes.

sa: चन्द्रे लक्ष्मीः प्रभा सूर्ये गतिर्वायौ भुवि क्षमा। एतच्च नियतं नित्यं त्वयि चानुत्तमं यशः॥
en: Ever manifested itself in you, glory Par excellence like to splendour in the Moon, lustre in the Sun, motion in the wind and forgiveness in the Earth.

sa: इह मे भरतो दृष्टो मातरश्च सनागराः। सा च मे स्मृतिरन्वेति तान् नित्यमनुशोचतः॥
en: Here have I seen Bharata and my mother in company with the citizens. Overwhelmed with grief on my account, they ever recur to my memory.

sa: मायावी नाम तेजस्वी पूर्वजो दुन्दुभेः सुतः। तेन तस्य महद्वैरं वालिनः स्त्रीकृतं पुरा॥
en: There was one endued with energy, named Māyāvi. He was the eldest son of Dunduvī. Formerly there arose a mighty hostility between himself and Vali.

sa: या ते नरपते वृत्तिभरते लक्ष्मणे च या। सुग्रीवे चाङ्गदे राजस्तां चिन्तयितुमर्हसि ॥
en: O king, O lord of men, it behoveth you to regard Sugrīva and Angada in the same light in which you regardest Bharata and Laksmana.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वानरो रामं विरराम हरीश्वरः॥ न तमाश्वासयद् रामो वालिनं व्यक्तदर्शनम्। साधुसम्मतया वाचा धर्मतत्त्वार्थयुक्तया ॥ न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम। वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः॥
en: Having addressed Rāma thus the lord of monkeys stopped. Thereupon Rāma consoled Vāli, of clear understanding with the following moral words, acceptable to the Saints. O best of monkeys, do you not consider ourselves as well as yourself blameable. We are more conversant, than you, with the principles of religion.

sa: कृतान्तस्य गतिः पुत्र दुर्विभाव्या सदा भुवि। यस्त्वां संचोदयति मे वच आविध्य राघव॥
en: Incomprehensible is the action of Destiny in this world, Oh my son, as it drives you away to the forest, Oh Raghava, neglecting my request.

sa: किंन्निमित्तो जहारार्यां रावणस्तस्य किं मया। अपराधं तु यं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन हृता प्रिया॥
en: Why has Rāvaņa taken away by stealth the worshipful Jānki? What offence did I commit by him that he has carried away my dear one?

sa: भवान् स्निग्धः सुहृन्मह्यं गुरुश्च परमो महान्। वोढव्यो भवता चैव भारो यज्ञस्य चोद्यतः॥
en: You are my kind friend, and prime and mighty spiritual guide. Engaged in it, you will have to bear the entire burden of the ceremony.

sa: अनेन धनुषा राम हत्वा संख्ये महासुरान्। आजहार श्रियं दीप्तां पुरा विष्णुर्दिवौकसाम् ॥ तद्धनुस्तौ च तूणी च शरं खङ्गं च मानद। जयाय प्रतिगृह्णष्व वज्रं वज्रधरो यथा॥
en: Having, O Rama, slain the mighty Asuras with this bow, Vişņu in days of yorc in battle secured the effulgent Fortune of the celestials. O bestower of honour, do you for securing victory, take this bow, these quivers, this arrow, and this scimitar, like the holder of the thunderbolt, taking the same.

sa: इयमेकपदी राजन् यतो मे पितुराश्रमः॥ तं प्रसादय गत्वा त्वं न त्वा संकुपितः शपेत्।
en: This narrow way, O king, will lead you to my father's dwelling. Do you going there, pacify him, so that getting wroth he may not curse you.

sa: तं तु मां जीवलोकोऽयं नूनमाक्रोष्टुमर्हति। मया ह्यपितृकः पुत्रः स महात्मा दुरात्मना ॥
en: Surely, people will be justified in condemning me wicked-minded that I am, for my son having been deprived of his ancestral kingdom by me; saying.

sa: स त्वं प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कुरुष्व मम पुत्रके। मम चैवाल्पभाग्यस्य दैवतं हि भवान् गुरुः॥
en: Therefore, do you, O you versed in morality, extend your favour to my son! Of slender fortune as I am, you are my guide and my god.

sa: पाणिप्रदानकाले च यत् पुरा त्वग्निसंनिधौ। अनुशिष्टं जनन्या मे वाक्यं तदपि मे धृतम्॥
en: And what also my mother taught me in presence of fire on the occasion of the bestowal of my hand, is also remembered by me.

sa: लोभात्तु मत्कृते नूनं नानुगच्छसि राघवम्। व्यसनं ते प्रियं मन्ये स्नेहो भ्रातरि नास्ति ते॥
en: Truely being under the influence of lust for me you did not follow Rāghava! For this you did welcome Rāma's disaster; you have no affection for him.

sa: स्वराज्यं राघवः पातु भव त्वं विगतज्वरा। नहि ते राघवादन्यः क्षमः पुरवरे वसन्॥
en: Let therefore Rāghava govern his kingdom; and do you remove your agitation. Surely save Rāghava none residing in the kingdom will prove friendly to you.

sa: ये शोकमनुवर्तन्ते न तेषां विद्यते सुखम्। तेजश्च क्षीयते तेषां न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Those that indulge in sorrow, know no happiness; and their virtue* goeth out of them. Therefore it behoveth you not to grieve. In the sense of energy.

sa: अम्ब केनात्यगाद् राजा व्याधिना मय्यनागते। धन्या रामादयः सर्वे यैः पिता संस्कृतः स्वयम्॥
en: Of what ailment has the king breathed his last during my absence? Blessed are Rāma and others who have personally performed my sire's last rites.

sa: सा चित्रकूटे भरतेन सेना धर्म पुरस्कृत्य विधूय दर्पम्। प्रसादनार्थं रघुनन्दनस्य विरोचते नीतिमता प्रणीता॥
en: And keeping morality in their fore-front, and renouncing pride, the disciplined forces schooled by Bharata in view of pleasing that descendant of Raghu (Rāma), stayed in Citrakuța.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा भरतः श्रीमान् मुमोद सहबान्धवः। अत्र राम इति ज्ञात्वा गतः पारमिवाम्भसः॥
en: Having seen this, like one that has crossed over the ocean, the graceful Bharata, concluding that Rāma was there, rejoiced exceedingly along with his friends.

sa: नेच्छता तात मां हन्तुं तदा वीरेण रक्षितः। रामस्य शरवेगेन निरस्तो भ्रान्तचेतनः॥ पातितोऽहं तदा तेन गम्भीरे सागराम्भसि। प्राप्य संज्ञां चिरात् तात लङ्कां प्रति गतः पुरीम्॥
en: He had no mind of killing me then and for this he saved my life. I was thrown however into the deep ocean being hindered by the velocity of his arrows and having lost my consciousness. Regaining my sense after a long while I returned to the city of Lankā.

sa: अभिवादये त्वां भगवन् सुखमस्म्युषितो निशाम्। आमन्त्रये त्वां गच्छामि गुरुं ते द्रष्टुमग्रजम् ॥
en: O reverend Sir, I salute you. I have pleasantly passed the night. I greet you; I shall go to behold my preceptor, your elder brother.

sa: गुहेन सार्धं तत्रैव स्थितोऽस्मि दिवसान् बहून्। आशया यदि मां रामः पुनः शब्दापयेदिति ॥
en: Indulging in the hope that Rāma might again summon me by any of the envoys (of Guha left there), I stayed there with Guha for many days.

sa: पिता हि भवति ज्येष्ठो धर्ममार्यस्य जानतः। तस्य पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि स हीदानी गतिर्मम ॥
en: The eldest brother of one that is noble and cognisant of morality, becomes his father. I shall take hold of his feet: he is now my refuge.

sa: इमा हि ते परिषदो ज्ञातयश्च नृपास्तथा। एषु तात चरन् धर्मं नातिवर्तेः सतां गतिम् ॥ वृद्धाया धर्मशीलाया मातुर्हिस्यवर्तितुम्। अस्या हि वचनं कुर्वन् नातिवर्तेः सतां गतिम्॥
en: These courtiers of yours, these relatives, and these kings;, by protecting them virtuously you will not lose the state of the righteous. It does not behove you to disregard the words of your aged and virtuous mother. By doing her bidding you will not lose the state of the righteous.

sa: अथ जिज्ञाससे मां त्वं भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये। आस्तु यत्तत्त्वया पूर्वं व्याहृतं राघवं प्रति॥
en: You (often) asked me whether I love Bharata or not. Be that which you had formerly told me in favour of that descendant of Raghu.

sa: कृतक्षणाहं भद्रं ते गमनं प्रति राघव। वनवासस्य शूरस्य मम चर्या हि रोचते॥
en: For your welfare, O Raghava, having received your permission to follow you, I like to serve you, O great hero, while living in the forest.

sa: निर्वीर्य इति लोको मां निर्दयश्चेति वक्ष्यति ॥ कातरत्वं प्रकाशं हि सीतापनयने स मे।
en: Surely shall the people blame me as being cruel and destitute of energy. That I have no prowess has already been manifested in the destruction of Sītā.

sa: अहो त्वं कर्णिकाराद्य पुष्पितः शोभते भृशम्। कर्णिकारप्रियां साध्वी शंस दृष्टा यदि प्रिया॥
en: O Karnikar, you appear very beautiful with this blossoming flowers, tell me if you have seen my dear devoted wife who was fond of you.

sa: किं ते व्यवसितं राजन् प्रोषिते मय्यनागते। विवास्य रामं धर्मज्ञं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्॥
en: O king, what was it that you had intended to do, I absent and away from home, by banishing righteous Rāma and the powerful Lakşmana?

sa: अहं वास्य रणे मृत्युरेष वा समरे मम। विनिवर्त्य रणोत्साहं मुहूर्तं प्राश्निको भव॥
en: Either I shall prove his death in battle, or he shall prove mine. Restraining your martial ardour, do you for a while become a witness.

sa: दुर्वृत्तमपि कः पुत्रं त्यजेद् भुवि विचक्षणः॥ कश्च प्रव्राज्यमानो वा नासूयेत् पितरं सुतः।
en: What sensible man for sake his son, albeit he may be wicked? And what son being banished, does not bear ill will towards his father?

sa: पुत्रस्ते सदृशः पुत्र भविष्यति सुधार्मिकः। गाधि प्राप्स्यसि तेन त्वं कीर्तिं लोके च शाश्वतीम्॥
en: O son, there will be born to you a virtuous son like to thyself: you will obtain even Gādhi, and through him enduring fame in this world.

sa: भविष्यति हि मे रूपं प्लवमानस्य सागरम्। विष्णोः प्रक्रममाणस्य तदा त्रीन् विक्रमानिव ॥
en: And at the time of leaping over the ocean, my form shall resemble that of the energizing Vişņu, when He had assumed the triune energy.

sa: एष पन्था महर्षीणां फलान्याहरतां वने। अनेन तु वनं दुर्गं गन्तुं राघव ते क्षमम्।।२१
en: This is the path of the Maharșis, who procure fruits in the forest. By this way you will be able to enter the impracticable wild, O Rāghava.

sa: यद्येतदशुभं कर्म न स्म मे कथयेः स्वयम्। फलेन्मूर्धा स्म राजन् सद्यः शतसहस्रधा॥
en: If, O king, you had not of yourself immediately communicated to us this unpleasant news, your head would have been reduced to a thousand flaws.

sa: जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा निषसाद महामुनिः॥ पुरोधा ऋत्विजश्चैव राजा च सहमन्त्रिभिः। आसनेषु यथान्यायनुपविष्टाः समन्ततः॥
en: Hearing Janaka's words, the mighty ascetic sat him down. And the king also, in company with his priests and counsellors sat down around in order of rank.

sa: तथैव रामोऽश्रुमुखः कृताञ्जलिः स्थितोऽब्रवील्लक्ष्मणबाहुपालितः। तथैव सीता रुदती तपस्विनी निरीक्षते राजरथं तथैव माम्॥
en: Thus said Rāma ministered to by Lakşmaņa, with a tearful countenance; and thus stood the unfortunate and weeping Sītå beholding the royal car and myself.

sa: भरतश्चेत् प्रतीतः स्याद् राज्यं प्राप्यैतदव्ययम्। यन्मे स दद्यात् पित्र) मा मां तद्दत्तमागमत्॥
en: If Bharata is satisfied with receiving this entire kingdom, let not what he spends on account of my funeral obsequies find its way to me.

sa: इहाश्रमपदेऽस्माकं बहवः पुण्यदर्शनाः। मृगाश्चरन्ति सहिताश्चमराः सृमरास्तथा॥ ऋक्षाः पृषतसङ्घाश्च वानराकिन्नरास्तथा। विहरन्ति महाबाहो रूपश्रेष्ठा महाबलाः॥ न चान्यः सदृशो राजन् दृष्टः पूर्वं मृगो मया। तेजसा क्षमया दीप्या यथायं मृगसत्तमः॥
en: Many a beautiful deer range at large in the vicinity of our hermitage such as Camaras, Srmaras, Rksas, Prsatas, Vanaras and Kinnaras. They are all very beautiful and of mighty strength; but O Prince, I have never seen before the like of this deer. In energy, strength and beauty it stands above all deer.

sa: ये चापि त्वं महाबाहो प्रत्युद्यान्ति नराधिपाः। तैविग्रहो यथा न स्यात् तथा कार्यं त्वयानघ॥
en: Those kings, O mighty-armed hero who will come forward to encounter you, try O sinless one, to avoid battles with them to the best of your power.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कोऽसौ नकुलरूपेण शिरसा काञ्चनेन वै। प्राह मानुषवद् वाचमेतत् पृष्टो वदस्व मे॥
en: Janamejaya said Who was that mungoose with a golden head, which said all those words in a human voice? Asked by me, do you tell me this.

sa: आचक्ष्व विषयं राजन् सोऽन्यस्य विषये राज्ञो वस्तुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो। वचस्ते कर्तुमिच्छामि यथाशास्त्रं महीपते॥
en: I wish, O lord, to live within the dominions of another king. Indeed, I wish to obey your command, O king, according to the scriptures.

sa: तत्र मित्रबलं राजन् मौलं चैव विशिष्यते। श्रेणीबलं भृतं चैव तुल्ये एवेति मे मतिः॥
en: Among all these, power of allies and power of riches are superior to the rest. The power of classes and that of the standing army are equal.

sa: यदा तु परमामातिं गतोऽसौ सपुरो नृपः। ततः प्रदध्मौ स करं प्रादुरासीत् ततो बलम्॥
en: And when he had reached the worst point of misery along with the citizens, he blew his hand, and from that there appeared a supply of forces.

sa: अपि दृष्टस्त्वया तत्र कुशली स कुरूद्वहः। गान्धारी च पृथा चैव सूतपुत्रश्च संजयः॥
en: Have you seen him there? Is that perpetuator o Kuru's race in peace? Are Gandhari and Pritha and the Suta's son Sanjaya also in peace?

sa: स्त्रियास्तु यद् भवेद् वित्तं पित्रा दत्तं युधिष्ठिर। ब्राह्मण्यास्तेद्धरेत् कन्या यथा पुत्रस्तथा हि सा॥
en: Whatever riches, O Yudhishthira, the Bralımani wife may acquire by gift from her father, should be taken by her daughter, for the daughter is like the son.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इदं खलु मया राजन् श्रुतमासीत् पुरातनम्। उपवासविधौ श्रेष्ठा गुणा ये भरतर्षभ॥
en: Bhishma said Formerly, O king, I heard of these high merits O chief of Bharata's race, as belonging to the observance of fasts according to the ordinance.

sa: कान्ताभिरपरांस्तत्र परिष्वक्तान् ददर्श ह। न ददर्श च तान् भूयो ददर्श च पुनर्नृपः॥
en: And he saw other Gandharvas at other places rejoicing with their dear wives. The king sometimes saw these sights and sometimes could not see them.

sa: गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च। गावो मे सर्वतश्चैव गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्॥
en: Kine are always at my front. Kine are always at my rear. Kine are on every side of my body. I live in the midst of kine.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां म्लेच्छानां च पितामह। उपवासे मतिरियं कारणं च न विद्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, all the orders of men, including the very Mlechchhas, are naturally disposed to observe fasts. We, however, do not know the reason thereof.

sa: भीष्म उवाच गविजातः प्रतापवान्। नहुषस्य वचः श्रुत्वा उवाच हर्षयन् सर्वानमात्यान् पार्थिवं च तम्॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of Nahusha, the ascetic born of a cow and gifted with great energy spoke thus, gladdening the monarch with all his counsellors:

sa: गौतम उवाच दक्षिणा परितोषो वै गुरुणां सद्धिरुच्यते। तव ह्याचरतो ब्रह्मस्तुष्टोऽहं वै न संशयः॥
en: Gautama said The good say that the satisfaction of the preceptor is the final fee. Forsooth, O twiceborn one, I have been highly pleased with your conduct.

sa: वपुष्मन्त्यो वयं सर्वाः किमस्माकं त्वयाद्य वै। यथेष्टं गम्यतां तत्र कृतकार्या वयं त्वया।॥
en: As regards ourselves, all of us have good forms. What need have we with you? Go wherever you like. You have already pleased us greatly.

sa: यत्र तद् ब्रह्म निर्द्वन्द्वं यत्र सोमः सहाग्निना। व्यवायं कुरुते नित्यं धीरो भूतानि धारयन्॥
en: There lives Brahma transcending all pairs of opposites; there Soma with Agni; and there the mover of the under standing, (viz., Vayu) always moves, upholding all creatures.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ईहमानः समारम्भान् यदि नासादयेद् धनम्। उग्रं तपः समारोहेन ह्यनुप्तं प्ररोहति॥
en: Bhishma said If one, by performing arduous works, fails to acquire wealth, he should then practise severe austeritics. Unless seeds be sown, no crops appear.

sa: किं च कृत्वा परं स्थानं प्राप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः। केन देवाः पवित्रेण स्वर्गमश्नन्ति वा विभो॥
en: What is that act by doing which wise men succeed in acquiring the highest region? What is that sacred deed by which the celestials enjoy divine happiness?

sa: सप्त विप्रांस्ततो भोज्ये युगपत् समुपानयत्। ऋते च लवणं भोज्यं श्यामाकानं ददौ प्रभुः॥
en: Approaching seven such Brahmanas whom he had brought to his house together, the powerful Nimi gave them food consisting of Shyamaka rice, unmixed with salt.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। शृणु राजन् वसिष्ठस्य मुख्यं कर्म यशस्विनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, king Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more said, Hear, O king, one of the great feats of the illustrious Vasishtha.

sa: तदा तान् दुःखितान् ज्ञात्वा आनृशंस्य परो मुनिः। अयत्नेनादहत् सर्वान् खलिनः स्वेन तेजसा॥ ते
en: Understanding that the gods had become greatly dispirited, the ascetic did this through mercy. He displayed his energy and burnt, without any exertion, those Danavas called Khalins.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्तु तान् सर्वान् पश्यन् दिव्येन् चक्षुषा। मुमुदे भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रसादात् तस्य वै मुनेः॥
en: Dhritarashtra seeing all those heroes with their celestial vision obtained through the favour of that sage, became full of joy, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्तु तान् सर्वान् पश्यन् दिव्येन् चक्षुषा। मुमुदे भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रसादात् तस्य वै मुनेः॥
en: Dhritarashtra seeing all those heroes with their celestial vision obtained through the favour of that sage, became full of joy, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: यो वै द्यूतेधनं जित्वा गाः क्रीत्वा सम्प्रयच्छति। स दिव्यमयुतं शक्र वर्षाणां फलमश्नुते॥
en: He who makes a gift of a cow, having acquired it with money, won at dice, enjoys happiness, O Shakra, for ten thousand celestial years.

sa: स तैः परिवृतो राजा शुशुभेऽतीव कौरवः। बिभ्रद् ब्राह्मीं श्रियं दीप्तां देवैरिव बृहस्पतिः॥
en: The old Kuru king, surrounded by them looked highly beautiful, indeed, he blazed with a Vedic splendour like Brihaspati in the midst of the celestials.

sa: महापुण्यां च गगनात् पतन्तीं वै महेश्वरः। दधार शिरसा गङ्गां तामेव दिवि सेवते॥
en: When that highly sacred river dropped from the sky, Maheshvara held it on his head. It is that very river which is worshipped in heaven.

sa: पराहि सा गति पार्थं तद् ब्रह्म सनातनम्। यत्रामृतत्वं प्राप्नोति त्यक्त्वा देहं सदा सुखी॥
en: That goal, O son of Pritha, is the highest which is forined by eternal Brahman where (Onc, renouncing the body, attains to immortality and becomes always happy.

sa: अस्ति काचिद् विवक्षा तु तां मे निगदतः शृणु। धृतराष्ट्र प्रति नृपं देवर्षे लोकपूजित॥
en: I wish to ask you something. Listen to me as I say it. It is about king, Dhritarashtra,O celestial Rishi, that are adored of all the worlds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्य तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा भीष्मो महामनाः। परीक्ष्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said The great Bhishma, hearing these words of Yudhishthira, reflected upon them acutely with the help of his understanding, and addressed Yudhishthira in reply.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ततस्तस्योपसंगृह्य पादौ प्रश्नान् सुदुर्वचान्। पप्रच्छ तांश्च धर्मान् स प्राह धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Touching the feet of that sage Brahmana asked him some very difficult questions. That foremost of all pious persons then described those duties that were referred to.

sa: शब्दं स्पर्श रस गन्धं भोगांश्चोच्चवचान् बहून्। नाभिजानासि कीट त्वं श्रेयो मरणमेव ते॥
en: Sound touch, taste, scent, and various kinds of excellent enjoyments are unknown to you, O worm! I think death will prove a benefit to you.

sa: न शौद्रं कर्म कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणेन विपश्चिता। शौद्रं हि कुर्वतः कर्म धर्मः समुपस्थ्यते॥
en: A Brahmana endued with learning should never do that which is laid down for the Shudras. By doing such acts, a Brahmana loses his merit.

sa: न क्वचित् सुखमत्यन्तं न क्वचिच्छाश्वती स्थितिः। स्थानाच्च महतो भ्रंशो दुःखलब्धात् पुनः पुनः॥
en: Nowhere one can enjoy the highest happiness; nowhere one can live for good. There are repeated falls from the highest regions acquired with such sorrow.

sa: भवितारश्च तस्याथ सर्वे कामा यथेप्सिताः। प्रेत्य स्वर्गं च लभते नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: That man will find all his wishes fulfilled, Departing from this world he will ascend to the celestial region. There is no doubt in this.

sa: तथैव रथमारुह्य नाप्सु चर्या विधीयते॥ एवं कर्म कृतं चित्रं विषयस्थं पृथक् पृथक्।
en: Likewise, it is not possible in moving abut on water after one has got on a car. There are thus various actions about various objects.

sa: धुर्यप्रदानेन गवां तथा वै लोकानवाप्नोति नरो वसूनाम्। स्वर्गाय चाहस्तु हिरण्यदानं ततो विशिष्टं कनकप्रदानम्॥
en: By making gifts of draft bullocks, a person acquires the region of the Vasus. Gift of gold secures Heaven. Gift of pure gold yields greater merit still.

sa: कः शक्रोत्यन्यथाकर्तुं तद् यदि स्यात् तथा शृणु। यत्र कृष्णो हि भगवांस्तत्र पुष्टिरनुत्तमा॥
en: Who is there who can transcend Krishna in these attributes? Whether that is possible or not, listen. Peerless Excellence prevails where the illustrious Krishna is.

sa: तेनैव च स कालेन प्रत्यबुद्ध्यत वीर्यवान्। न च तौ चक्रतुः किंचिद् विकारं भयशङ्कितौ॥
en: Gifted with great energy, he thus passed another twentyone days. Moved by fear, the royal pair showed no change in their attitude or sentiment towards the Rishi.

sa: घ्राण जिह्वा च चक्षुश्च त्वक् श्रोत्रं मन एव च। न निष्ठामधिगच्छन्ति बुद्धिस्तामधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the tongue, the eye, the skin, the ear, and the mind, succeed in apprehending determination. It is the understanding alone which apprehends it.

sa: विस्मितौ तमृषि दृष्ट्वा तदाश्चर्ये विचिन्त्य च। दर्शनात् तस्य तु तदा विश्रान्तौ सम्बभूवतुः॥
en: Seeing the Rishi there, they wondered much. Indeed, they began to think upon that very strange incident. The sight of the Rishi removed their fatigue.

sa: पुष्पोपगं वाथ फलोपंग वा यः पादपं स्पर्शयते द्विजाया सश्रीकमृद्धं बहुरत्नपूर्ण लभत्ययत्नोपगतं गृहं वै॥
en: One who gives flowers and fruits and plants and trees to a Brahmana, acquires, without any toil, a palatial residence containing beautiful women and plenty of riches.

sa: ततः स्थिते त्वयि विभो लघुत्वात् प्रलपामहे। न हि किंचित् तदाश्चर्यं यन्न वेत्ति भवानिह॥
en: Indeed, in Your presence, O Powerful One, we indulge in incoherencies from the lightness of our hearts. There is no wonderful thing which You do not know.

sa: पत्रोर्णं चोरयित्वा तु कृकलत्वं निगच्छति। कौशिकं तु ततो हत्वा नरो जायति वर्तकः॥
en: By stealing a piece of silken cloth, one becomes a Krikara. By stealing a piece of cloth made of red silk, one becomes a Vartaka.

sa: ततः स पश्चिमं देशं समुद्रस्य तदा हयः। क्रमेण व्यचरत् स्फीतं ततः पञ्चनदं ययौ॥
en: The sacrificial horse then proceeded along the coast of the western ocean and at last reached the country of the five waters full of population and prosperity.

sa: ततोऽगस्त्यः सुरपतिं वाक्यमाह विशाम्पते। योजयस्वेति मां क्षिप्रं कं च देशं वहामि ते॥
en: Seeing the king of the celestials, Agastya addressed him, saying, Do you yoke me to your vehicle forthwith! To what region shall I bear you.

sa: तत्र शंकुपताके द्वे युगान्तं कल्पमेव च। अयुतायुतं तथा पद्मं समुद्रं च तथा वसेत्॥
en: That resolute resides in the abode of Brahma for the period counted as two Shankha, two Mahapadma, a Kalpa, four ages, ten crore and four Padma years.

sa: संस्मृत्य तदहं सम्यक् कर्तुमिच्छामि पाण्डवाः। आयत्यां च तदात्वे च सर्वेषां तद्धि नो हितम्॥
en: Remembering those words, you sons of Pandu, I wish to obey them duly! By obeying those words of theirs great blessedness will belong to all of you.

sa: यत्र वक्ष्यसि विप्रर्षे तत्र यास्यति ते रथः।३४॥ एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान् प्रत्युवाचाथ तं नृपम्। इत: प्रभृति यातव्यं पदकं पदकं शनैः॥ श्रमो मम यथा न स्यात् तथा मच्छन्दचारिणौ।
en: This your chariot shall proceed to the place which you may be pleased to direct! Thus addressed, the holy' man replied to the king, saying-Let the car go hence, dragged slowly, step by step. Obeying my will, do you two proceed in such a way that I may not feel any exhaustion.

sa: तच्च नाकरवं कृष्ण नृशंसां जीवितप्रिया। इदानीं मां गतां तत्र किं नु वक्ष्यति फाल्गुनिः॥
en: I did not, however, keep my vow, cruel that I am and fond of life! If I go to him now, what indeed, will Phalguna's son say?

sa: ततो रक्षांसि सर्वाणि नेशुस्त्यक्त्वा गुहं तु तत्। अन्तरिक्षे च वागासीत् साधु केशव साध्विति॥
en: All the Rakshasas were forced to leave the room and many of them were killed. In the sky a voice was heard, saying, Excellent, O Keshava, Excellent.

sa: स चम्पां नगरीमेत्य पुष्पाणि गुरवे ददौ। पूजयामास च गुरुं विधिवत् स गुरुप्रियः॥
en: Coming to the city of Champa, he gave the flowers to his preceptor. Devoted to superiors and seniors, he adored his preceptor in due form.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच शृणु मे विस्तरेणेदं यद् वक्ष्ये भृगुनन्दन। गृहाणानुनयं चापि तपस्वी ह्यसि भार्गव॥
en: O scion of Bhrigu's race listen, to what I say in full. Do you accept my apologies also. O you of Bhrigu's race you are an ascetic!

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामहेन विधिवद् यज्ञाः प्रोक्ता महात्मना। गुणाश्चैषां यथातथ्यं प्रेत्य चेह च सर्वशः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, you have duly described to us the subject of Sacrifices, including the merits in full that attach to them both here and hereafter.

sa: रोचते मे महाबाहो गमनं तव केशव। मातुलश्चिरदृष्टो मे त्वया देवी च देवकी॥
en: O mighty-armed Keshava, your departure is approved by me! You have not seen my maternal uncle as also the goddess Devaki for a long time.

sa: स्मरेथाश्चापि मां नित्यं भीमं च बलिना वरम्। फाल्गुनं सहदेवं च नकुलं चैव मानद॥
en: Do you also think of me daily as also of Bhima, that foremost of powerful men, and of Phalguna and Nakula and Sahadeva, O giver of honours.

sa: श्रुत्वा च मे तदध्यात्म मुञ्चेथाः शापमद्य वै। न च मां तपसाऽल्पेन शक्तोऽभिभवितुं पुमान्॥
en: After having heard my words about the soul, you may then utter your curse. No man is able, by a little ascetic merit, to put me down.

sa: विनश्यत्सु च भूतेषु न भयं तस्य जायते। क्लिश्यमानेषु भूतेषु न स क्लिशति केनचित्॥
en: He does not fear even at on seçing all creatures falling victims to destruction. When all creatures are afflicted, he can never be afflicted by any one.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अर्थाल्लोभाद् वा कामाद् वा वर्णानां चाप्यनिश्चयात्। अज्ञानाद् वापि वर्णानां जायते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: Yudhishthira said The intermixture of castes is brought about through inducements offered by richies, or through mere lust, or through ignorance of the true order of birth.

sa: कल्य उत्थाय यो मर्त्यः स्पृशेद् गां वै घृतं दधि। सर्षपं च प्रियर्थं च कल्मषात् प्रतिमुच्यते॥
en: That man who rising early dawn, touches a cow, clarified butter and curds, as also mustard seeds and the larger variety thereof called Priyangu, becomes purged off of all his sins.

sa: पश्चिमां दिशमाश्रित्य य एधन्ते निबोध तान्। उषङ्गुः सह सोदर्यैः परिव्याधश्च वीर्यवान्॥ ऋर्षिर्दीर्घतमाश्चैव गौतमः काश्यपस्तथा। एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चैव महानृषिः॥ अत्रेः पुत्रश्च धर्मात्मा तथा सारस्वतः प्रभुः। उत्तरां दिशमाश्रित्य य एधन्ते निबोध तान्॥
en: Listen now to me as I name those Rishis who live in the Western quarter. They are Ushangu with his uterine brothers, greatly energetic, Dirghatamas, Gautama, Kashyapa, Ekata, Dvita, Trita, the righteous-souled son of Atri (viz., Durvasa). and and the powerful Sarasvati, Listen now to me as I name those Rishis who adore the celestial in sacrifices, living in the Northern region.

sa: अशोभन्त महाराज ग्रहास्तारागणैरिव॥ राजभ्योऽपि ततः प्रादाद् रत्नानि विविधानि च। गजानश्वानलं कारान् स्त्रियो वासांसि काञ्चनम्।।३२
en: To those kings they made presents of various jewels and gems, and elephants and horses and ornaments of gold, and female slaves and cloths and immense quantity of gold.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयता पावकश्चापि तेजस्वी कृत्वा कार्यं दिवौकसाम्॥ जगामेष्टं ततो देशं तदा भार्गवनन्दन।
en: Having said these words, the goddess-disappeared. The highly energetic god of fire also, having performed the business of the celestials, proceeded to the place he liked, O delighter of the Bhrigus.

sa: घृतं मे हृदये नित्यं घृतं नाभ्यां प्रतिष्ठितम्। घृतं सर्वेषु गात्रेषु घृतं मे मनसि स्थितम्॥
en: Clarified butter is always in my heart. Clarified butter is even established in my navel. Clarified butter is in every limb of mine. Clarified butter lives in my mind.

sa: रुद्रः स च शिवः सोऽग्निः सर्वः स सर्वजित्। स चैवेन्द्रश्च वायुश्च सोऽश्विनौ स च विद्युतः॥
en: He is Rudra; he is Shiva; he is Agni; he is Sarva; he is the defeater of all; he is Indra, and Vayu, and the Ashvins and the god of lightning.

sa: सोऽनुनीतो भगवता विष्टरश्रवसा स्वयम्। द्वैपायनेन कृष्णेन देवस्थानेन वा विभुः॥ नारदेनाथ भीमेन नकुलेन च पार्थिव। कृष्णया सहदेवेन विजयेन च धीमता॥ अन्यैश्च पुरुषव्याप्रैाह्मणैः शास्त्रदृष्टिभिः। व्यजहाच्छोक्जं दुःखं संतापं चैव मानसम्॥
en: And, O monarch, that king exhorted by the worshipful Vishtarashraba himself, and by Dvaipayana (Vyasa), Krishna, Devasthana. Narada, Bhima, Nakula, Krishna (Draupadi), Sahadeva, and the sharp-witted Vijaya, as well as by other great men, and Brahmanas versed in the scriptures, became relieved of all mental suffering and sorrow originating from the death of his dear relations.

sa: दत्तस्येह फलं किं च वेदानां धारणे च किम्। अध्यापने फलं किं च सर्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: What are the fruits of gifts, and what those of keeping the Vedas in memory? What are the fruits of teaching the Vedas? I wish to know all this.

sa: न च संध्यामुपासीत न च जाप्यं प्रवर्तयेत्। न संकिरेत् तदन्नं च ततः पूयेत ब्राह्मणः॥
en: Without performing his ablutions Brahmana should not recite his evening prayers nor engage in religious meditation, nor take his food a second time. By so doing he is purified.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स महातेजाः शुकः पित्रा महात्मना। पूजयामास गां नित्यं तस्मात् त्वमपि पूजय॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by his great father, Shuka, gifted with great energy, began from that time to adore kine every day. Do you also, O son, act thus.

sa: या नापश्यंश्चन्द्रमसं न सूर्य रामाः कदाचिदपि तस्मिन् नरेन्द्र। महावनं गच्छति कौरवेन्द्रे शोकेनार्ता राजमार्ग प्रपेदुः॥
en: Ladies who had never seen the sun or the moon, came out into the streets on that occasion, in grcat sorrow, when king Dhritarashtra proceeded towards the great forest.

sa: प्राणादाने निवृत्तोऽसि हिंसायां वर्तते भवान्। नास्ति चेष्टा विना हिंसां किं वा त्वं मन्यसे द्विज।।२१
en: You do not then abstain from taking life. Really, you are engaged in slaughter. There can be no movement without destruction. Or, what do you think. O twice-born one.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु ये केचित् प्राणिनः सर्व एव ते। तर्प्यमाणाः परां तृप्तिं यान्ति गङ्गाजलैः शुभैः॥
en: All the creatures in the three worlds, if served with the sacred waters of Ganga, derive a pleasure the like of which they cannot derive from any other source.

sa: तारितो हि त्वया देहो लोके कीर्तिः स्थिरा च ते॥ सभार्यः सहपुत्रश्च सस्नुषश्च दिवं व्रजा
en: You have rescued your body. The fame of your achievement will least in the world. With your wife, your son, and your daughter-in-law, go now to the celestial region.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तु तं ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा तस्य दुःखेन दुःखितः। उत्तङ्कमब्रवीद् वाक्यं नैतच्छक्यं त्वयेति वै॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : LoO king like a Brahmana stricken with the sorrow of Utanka, the king of the celestials addressed him, saying, 'This (purpose of thine) is impracticable of being accomplished.

sa: देवशर्मन् उवाच यद् वै तन्मिथुनं ब्रह्मन्नहोरात्रं हि विद्धि तत्। चक्रवत् परिवर्तेत तत् ते जानाति दुष्कृतम्॥
en: Devasharman said The first couple, O twiceborn one, whom you saw, are, Day and Night. They are ceaselessly moving like a circle. Both of them know the sin you have committed.

sa: सर्प उवाच दानं च सत्यं तत्त्वं वा अहिंसा प्रियमेव च। एषां कार्यगरीयस्त्वाद् दृश्यते गुरुलाघवम्॥
en: The Snake replied The superiority or inferiority among charity, truthfulness, forbearance from malice and sweet speech is estimated at by the benefit which each of these tends to produce.

sa: ततः सर्वाः समापेतुर्मातरो भरतस्य ताः। उपवासकृशा दीना भर्तृव्यसनकर्शिताः॥ ताश्च तं पतितं भूमौ रुदत्यः पर्यवारयन्। कौसल्या त्वनुसृत्यैनं दुर्मनाः परिषस्वजे॥ वत्सला स्वं यथा वत्समुपगुह्य तपस्विनी। परिपप्रच्छ भरतं रुदती शोकलालसा॥
en: Thereat, all the mothers of Bharata, fasting, undergoing distress, and afflicted with the calamity that had befallen their lord, came forward, and surrounding Bharata, began to lament him fallen on the ground. And the distressed Kausalyā drawing nigh embraced him like a cow approaching her calf; and weeping from excess of grief, spoke to Bharata, saying.

sa: स त्व गुरुरिति प्रेम्णा मया सम्मानितो भृशम्। गुरुवृत्तिं न जीनीघे तस्माद योत्स्यामि वै त्वया॥
en: I respected you very much so long because you were my preceptor; but since you do not know the duties of a preceptor, therefore shall I fight with you.

sa: नारद उवाच कथयिष्ये सभां याम्यां युधिष्ठिर निबोध ताम्। वैवस्वतस्य यां पार्थ विश्वकर्मा चकार ह॥
en: Narada said O Yudhishthira, I shall now describe the assembly-hall of Yama, the son of Vaivasvata. O son of Pritha, it was built by Vishvakarma; hear all about it.

sa: अमी हि त्वां सुरसंघा विशन्ति केचिद् भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति। स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसंघाः स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः॥
en: Hosts of celestial enter into you, some perhaps being afraid pray with joined hands, saying Hail to thee. Hosts of great Rishis and Siddhyas praise you with innumerable hymns of praise.

sa: अद्य मे सफलं जन्म तारितं चाद्य मे कुलम्। अद्यायं तारितो देशो मम तार्क्ष्य त्वयानघ।॥
en: To-day is my birth blessed and my race absolved from sins; to-day is this country, over which I rule, freed from sins by you, O Tarkshya, who are sinless.

sa: अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञो न युद्धं तेन ते क्षमम्। बलिं वा नमुचिं वापि हन्याद्धि रघुनन्दनः॥
en: I am fully apprised of the prowess of that descendant of Raghu; it dose not behove you to enter into conflict with him; he can destroy Vāli and Namuci.

sa: इतीव तत् प्राश्य हविर्वरानना जहौ क्षुधादुःखसमुद्भवं च तम्। इन्द्रात् प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य जानकी काकुत्स्थयोः प्रीतमना बभूव ॥
en: Having thus eaten it, that one of excellent countenance, had her hunger and rising sorrow removed; and attaining a mental tendency from Indra, Janaki grew glad with reference to the Kakutsthas.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मत्समो यदि संग्रामे शरासनधरः क्वचित्। विद्यते तं समाचक्ष्व यः समासीत मां मृधे॥
en: If any holder of the bow exists that is equal to me in battle, and that would stand against mc in the field, do you name him to me.

sa: शुक्र उवाच समुद्रं प्रविशध्वं वा दिशो वा द्रवतासुराः। दुहितु प्रियं सोढुं शक्तोऽहं दयिता हि मे॥
en: Shukra said: O Asura, I care very little whether you go into the bottom of the sea, of fly away to all directions, I am incapable of bearing my daughter's grief.

sa: अहं तु प्रेषितो राजन् कौरवेण महात्मना। आमन्त्रयति वो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः॥ मनोऽभिलषितं राज्ञस्तं क्रतुं द्रष्टुमर्हथ।
en: "O king, I have been sent here by that illustrious Kuru king, the lord of men Dhritarashtra's son to invite you. You should therefore see that charming sacrifice of that king."

sa: हन्यमाने तु शैनेये क्रुद्धो रुक्मिणिनन्दनः। तदनन्तरमागच्छन्मोक्षयिष्यन् शिनेः सुतम्॥ स भोजैः सह संयुक्तः सात्यकिश्चान्धकैः सह।
en: When the son of Shini was being thus assaulted, Rukmini's son became greatly enraged. he rushed forward for rescuing Satyaki who was engaged with the Bhojas and the Andhaks.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच अपराधशतं क्षाम्यं मया ह्यस्य पितृष्वसः। पुत्रस्य ते वधार्हस्य मा त्वं शोके मनः कृथाः॥
en: Krishna Said O Aunt, even when he will deserve to be killed, in such one hundred (occasions of) offences of this (Shishupala), I will pardon him. Do not be (therefore) aggrieved.

sa: अग्निं त्वं यजसे नित्यं कस्माद् ब्राह्मणमर्जुन। स हि सर्वस्य लोकस्य हव्यवाट् किं न वेत्सि तम्।।
en: Why do yu, O Arjuna, adore Agni everyday who is a Brahmana? He is the bearer of sacrificial libations from every part of the universe. Are you ignorant of this fact.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं रामस्य पितरस्तदा॥ प्रत्यूचुः परमप्रीता राम हर्षसमन्विताः। तपस्ते वर्धतां भूयः पितृभक्त्या विशेषतः॥
en: Having heard these blessed words of Rama, the Pitris. Becoming highly pleased and filled with joy, thus replied to Rama, “Let your asceticism increase for your great filial piety.

sa: तं चेन्मृत्युः सर्वहरोऽभिरक्षेत् सदाप्रमत्तः समरे पाण्डुपुत्रम्। तं वा हनिष्यामि रणे समेत्य यास्यामि वा भीष्ममुखो यमाय॥
en: Even if death himself the destroyer of all, protects vigilantly the son of Pandu, in battle I will either kill him or go myself to the abode of death following Bhishma.

sa: सा हृष्टरूपेव तु राजपुत्री। तस्या वचः साधु विशङ्कमाना। यथावदुक्तं प्रचकार साध्वी ते चापि सर्वे बुभुजस्तदन्नम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having these excellent words of her mother-in-law, the chaste princess, then cheerfully did all that she was directed to do. And they then all partook of the food.

sa: सा तयोर्वचनाद् राजन्नुपसंगम्य भार्गवम्॥ उवाच वाक्यं यत् ताभ्यामुक्तं भृगुसुतं प्रति। तच्छ्रुत्वा च्यवनो भार्यामुवाच क्रियतामिति॥
en: O king, she went at their word to Bhrigu's son and told the son of Bhrigu what the two celestials had said. Having heard this, Chyavana said, "Do it."

sa: निवेश्य गङ्गामनु तां महानदी चमूं विधानैः परिबर्हशोभिनीम्। उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मो विचिन्तमानो भरतो निवर्तनम्॥
en: Having on the mighty stream, Gangā, quartered his forces furnished with all appliances for the journey, Bharata remained there, revolving the means of making the high-souled Rāma turn back.

sa: ततो दृष्ट्वा निहतं बभ्रुमाह कृष्णोऽग्रजं भ्रातरमुग्रतेजाः॥ इहैव त्वं मां प्रतीक्षस्व राम यावत् स्त्रियो ज्ञातिवशाः करोमि।
en: Seeing Vabhru killed, Keshava of great energy addressed his elder brother and said, 'Do you, O Rama, wait for me her till I put the ladies under the care of kinsmen.

sa: नाददानं शरान् घोरान् विमुञ्चन्तं महाबलम्।७।। न कार्मुकं विकर्षन्तं रामं पश्यामि संयुगे। हन्यमानं तु तत्सैन्यं पश्यामि शरवृष्टिभिः॥ इन्द्रेणेवोत्तमं सस्यमाहतं त्वश्मवृष्टिभिः। रक्षसां भीमवीर्याणां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश॥ निहतानि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तेनैकेन पदातिना। अर्धाधिकमुहूर्तेन खरश्च सहदूषणः॥ ऋषीणामभयं दत्तं कृतक्षेमाश्च दण्डकाः॥ एका कथंचित्मुक्ताहं परिभूय महात्मना । स्त्रीवधं शङ्कमानेन रामेण विदितात्मना॥ भ्राता चास्य महातेजा गुणतस्तुल्यविक्रमः।
en: I do not see in the field, Rāma drawing his bow: I only see the host being slaughtered by a shower of shafts. And as Indra destroys (a field of) goodly crops, by pouring down hail stones, fourteen thousand Räksasas of dreadful prowess, as well as Khara and Duşaņa were in a little over a moment slain with sharp shafts by Rāma alone fighting on foot. And he had reassured the saints, and after having been deformed, I alone from fear of slaying a woman, have been let off by the high-souled Rāma knowing self.

sa: तत् कर्म शाल्वस्य समीक्ष्य सर्वे पाञ्चालपुत्रा नृप सृञ्जयाश्च। हाहाकारैर्नादयन्ति स्म युद्धे द्विपं समन्ताद् रुरुधुनराग्र्याः॥
en: Beholding that feat of Shalya, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas and the Matsyas. O king, bewailed aloud in that battle. All those foremost of men however, surrounded the animal entirely.

sa: ततोऽपरान् पञ्चशतान् महात्मा नाराचमुख्यान् विससर्ज कुम्भे। स तैस्तु विद्धः परमद्विपो रणे तदा परावृत्य भृशं प्रदुद्रुवे॥
en: Then that illustrious hero struck the animal on the trunk with five other whetted and best arrows. Struck therewith, that prince of elephants, turning away from the battle, ran quickly away.

sa: वीक्षमाणश्च ददृशे परिघं तोरणाश्रितम्। स तं गृह्य महाबाहुः कालायसपरिष्कृतम्। रक्षिणस्तान् पुनः सर्वान् सूदयामास मारुतिः॥
en: And eyeing around, he saw a bolt standing against the gate. And that mighty-armed one, the Wind-god's son, taking up that bolt of burnished iron, again slaughtered the guards.

sa: मनुरुवाच यदा तैः पञ्चभिः पञ्च युक्तानि मनसा सह। अथ तद् रक्ष्यते ब्रह्म मणौ सूत्रमिवापितम्॥
en: Manu said When the five attributes are united with the five senses and the mind, then is Brahma seen by the individual like a thread passing through a gem.

sa: त्वया भोगवतीं मत्वा निर्जिताः पन्नगा युधि ॥ कैलासशिखरावासी यक्षैर्बहुभिरावृतः। सुमहत्कदनं कृत्वा वश्यस्ते धनदः कृतः॥
en: Repairing to Bhagavatī, you did discomfit the serpents in battle. The God of Death, living on mount Kailasa, encircled by Yaksas, was subjugated by you in a great battle.

sa: धूम्राक्षस्याथ सम्पातेर्भवनं मारुतात्मजः। विधुदूपस्य भीमस्य घनस्य विघनस्य च ॥ शुकनाभस्य चक्रस्य शठस्य कपटस्य च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य लोमशस्य च रक्षसः॥ युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य सादिनः। विद्युज्जिह्वद्विजिह्वानां तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च॥ करालस्य विशालस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। प्लवमानः क्रमेणैव हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः॥ तेषु तेषु महार्हेषु भवनेषु महायशाः। तेषामृद्धिमतामृद्धिं ददर्श स महाकपिः॥
en: And (next) the Wind-god's offspring entered the house of Dhumraksa, and (next) that of Sampāti, and the grim Vidyudrūpa, and Ghana, and Vighana, and Sukanābha, and Cakra, and Satha, and Kapata, and Hrasvakarna, and Danstra, and the Rākşasa Lomasa, and Yuddhyonmatta, and Matta, and the horseman, Dhvajagrīva, and of Vidyujjihva and Vijihva, and of Hastimukha, and of Karāla, and Vicala, and of Sonitaksha. The issustrious offspring of the Wind, Hanumān, one after another, leapt into all these noble edifices. And that redoubtable monkey observed the affluence of all these (Raksasas) possessed of prosperity.

sa: इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंश्च सीता पुनरथाब्रवीत्। कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी॥ तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय।
en: Thus addressed, Sītā again spoke to him, saying, Do you on my behalf, bowing down the head, enquire after the welfare of that protector of men whom Kausalyā has brought forth.

sa: मातुः कुलं पितृकुलं यत्र चैव च दीयते। कुलत्रयं सदा कन्यां संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति ॥
en: Whenever may a daughter be conferred, a daughter stayes, placing in uncertainly the three races* to which she is related. *The races respectively of her father, mother and husband.

sa: वधेन वै दाशरथेः सुखावह जयं तवाहर्तुमहं यतिष्ये।। हत्वा च रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन खादामि सर्वानहरियूथमुख्यान्॥
en: Be you comforted by slaying Daſaratha's son, I will exert to secure blessed victory for you. Having killed Rāma along with Lakşmaņa, I shall devour all the principal monkeys.

sa: तत्तेऽहं कीर्तयिष्यामि समाधि श्रवणे कुरु। पुरा कृतयुगे राम प्रजापतिसुतं प्रभुम्॥ सनत्कुमारमासीनं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। वपुषा सूर्यसंकाशं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा॥ विनयावनतो भूत्वा ह्यभिबाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। उक्तवानरावणो राम तमृषि सत्यवादिनम्॥ को हस्मिन्नवरो लोके देवानां बलवत्तरः। यं समाश्रित्य विबुधा जयन्ति समरे रिपून्॥ कं जयन्ति द्विजा नित्यं कं ध्यायन्ति च योगिनः। एतन्मे शंस भगवन्विस्तरेण तपोधन। ११॥ विदित्वा हृद्गतं तस्य ध्यानदृष्टिर्महायशाः। उवाच रावणं प्रेम्णा श्रूयतामिति पुत्रका॥
en: Do you hear it attentively. O Rāma, in the golden age, having bowed to the Patriarch's son, the truthful Rși Sanaskumar highly effulgent, resplendent like to the sun, shining in his native brilliance and seated at his own place, Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas, said:-"Which is now among the celestials can brave and powerful, by whose help the celestials can vanquish their enemies and whom the twice-born ones daily worship and the devotees meditate upon. O you having piety for wealth, O you gifted with six sorts of wealth, do you describe this to me kindly.” Being apprised of Ravana's intention, the saint Sanatkumar, who saw every thing through his devotion, said to him out of love-_ “Hear my son.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले॥ कामभोगाभिसंरक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे। सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा॥
en: Having said this, the Raksasa ravished her. Being released from his grasp Rambhā became divested of her ornaments and garland and became like the river agitated by the elephants.

sa: भरतं किं नु वक्ष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं च महाबलम्। सह तेन वनं यातो विना तेनागतः कथम्॥
en: What shall I say to Bharata, and what to the exceedingly powerful Satrughna? You had gone to the woods with him. Why then did you come (back) without him?

sa: तत्प्रयुक्तं पुनयुद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्॥ गदानां मुसलानां च परिघाणां च निःस्वनैः। शराणां पुरवातैश्च क्षुभिताः सप्त सागराः॥
en: There again ensued a terrible conflict capable of making one's down stand on end. And the seven oceans were overwhelmed with the sound of maces, Musalas, Paraighas and gold feathered arrows.

sa: न भीतोऽस्मि न मूढोऽस्मि नोपजप्तोऽस्मि शत्रुभिः न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहो विस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया॥
en: I am not afraid, nor stupefied, nor have I been bribed by the foe, nor am I negligent. And I have not forgotten your affection or your good offices.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच व्रीहिद्रोणः परित्यक्तः कथं तेन महात्मना। कस्मै दत्तश्च भगवन् विधिना केन चास्थ मे॥
en: Yudhisthira said: O exalted one, why did that highsouled one give away a Drona of corn? To whom and in what prescribed way he gave it. Tell me this.

sa: यतः प्राप्त: संजयः पाण्डवेभ्यो न मे यथावन्मनसः प्रशान्तिः। सर्वेन्द्रियाण्यप्रकृतिं गतानि किं वक्ष्यतीत्येव मेऽद्य प्रचिन्ता॥
en: Since Sanjaya has come back from the Pandavas, I have not my usual calmness of mind; all my senses are in disorders I am thinking what he will say.

sa: अजितं सर्वलोकानां देवैरपि दुरासदम्। मया दत्तं पाशुपतं दिव्यमप्रतिमं शरम्। अवाप लोकपालेभ्यो वलादीन् स महाशरान्॥
en: He is unconquerable by all men even by the celestials; I myself have given him the celestial shaft Pashupata. He obtained from the Lokapalas thunderbolt and other mighty shafts.

sa: अथवा विषमं प्राप्य विनष्टाः शाश्वतीः समाः। तस्मान्मानसमव्यग्रं कृत्वा त्वं कुरुनन्दन। कुरु कार्यं महोत्साहं मन्यसे यन्नराधिप॥
en: Or overtaken by some dreadful calamity, they have perished for ever. Therefore, O Kuru chief, removing all anxiety from your heart, acquire what you may, working with your energy, O king.

sa: विभेमि न तथा मृत्योर्यथा बिभ्येऽनृतादहम्। विशेषेण द्विजातीनां सर्वेषां सर्वदा सताम्॥ प्रदाने जीवितस्यापि न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा।
en: I do not fear death so much as falsehood. Especially for the sake of all the righteous twice-born ones ever, I am ready to sacrifice my life without (the least) hesitation.

sa: नारद उवाच अहो बत महत् पापं सावित्र्या नृपते कृतम्। अजानन्त्या यदनया गुणवान् सत्यवान् वृतः॥
en: Narada said: Alas, O king, Savitri has done a very foolish act in as much as she, has through ignorance, chosen for her husband, Satyavana endued with (high) qualities.

sa: किनुं कुर्यां कथं कुर्यां क्व नु गच्छामि संजय। एते नश्यन्ति कुरवो मन्दाः कालवशं गताः॥
en: What shall I do? how shall I do it and where shall I go, O Sanjaya? These foolish Kurus will be destroyed being subject to the effects of time.

sa: सुदेष्णोवाच नव त्वां जातु हिंस्यात् स इतः सम्प्रेषितां मया। इत्युक्त्वा प्रददौ पात्रं सपिधानं हिरण्मयम्॥
en: Sudeshna said "Dispatched by me from my palace he will hardly do any harm to you"; saying this she handed out to her a golden pot with a cover.

sa: समर्थो ह्यभवं पूर्वमसमर्थोऽस्मि साम्प्रतम्। कथं नु कार्यं भद्रं वो दुर्धर्षः स हि मे मतः॥
en: I was before this capable of (doing this) but at present I am incapable. I wish you well. What can I do? I think he is hard to vanquish.

sa: राम उवाच अभिवादये त्वां राजेन्द्र यदि त्वं जनको मम। गमिष्यामि पुरीं रम्यामयोध्यां शासनात् तव॥
en: Rama said : O king of kings, if you are my father I bow down to you. I will repair to the beautiful city of Ayodhya at your command.

sa: तपसा गुरुभक्त्या च भर्तुः स्नेहाद् व्रतेन च। तव चैव प्रसादेन न मे प्रतिहता गतिः॥
en: There shall be no obstacle to my course on account of my asceticism, my devotion to superiors, my affection for my husband, my observance of vows and your grace.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद् वाक्यं पार्थिवाः सर्वे हृदयैः समपूजयन्। न तत्र कश्चिद् वक्तं हि वाचं प्राक्रामदग्रतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said All the rulers of the earth, agreeing as they did in their minds with these words, could not venture to say any thing there in the presence (of Duryodhana).

sa: स्वयं हयानीक्षति मामकान् दृढं ध्रुवं हयज्ञो भविता विचक्षणः। प्रवेश्यतामेष समीपामाशु मे विभाति वीरो हि यथामरस्तथा॥
en: This person looks closely at my horses. Must he be proficient in horse-lore. Let him quickly enter into my presence. This heroic one seems to me as much as a celestials.

sa: यदत्र युक्तं प्राप्तं च तद् विधत्स्व विशाम्पते। उक्तं भीष्मेण यद् वाक्यं द्रोणेन विदुरेण च॥
en: Do that, O lord, which is suitable in this crisis, and under the present circumstances. The worlds that had been said by Bhishma, those by Drona and by Vidura,

sa: यक्ष उवाच को मोहः प्रोच्यते राजन् कश्च मानः प्रकीर्तितः। किमालस्यं च विज्ञेयं कश्च शोकः प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: The Yaksha said: O king, what is it that is called ignorance? What is spoken of as pride? What is understood by idleness? And what is it that is called grief?

sa: कर्ण उवाच अवनि प्रमदा गाश्च निवापं बहुवार्षिकम्। तते ते विप्र प्रदास्यामि न तु वर्म सकुण्डलम्॥
en: Karna said: O Brahmana, I will bestow on you homestead lands, beauteous women, cows and (sufficient) plots of land which will enable you to maintain yourself as long as you live.

sa: ते न हि साम्ना न दानेन शक्योऽर्थस्तेषु कश्चर। तस्मात् तेषु न कर्तव्या कृपा मधुसूदन॥
en: Not by peaceful means, nor by surrender can our object be gained from them; therefore, O destroyer of Madhu, mercy ought not to be shown to them by you.

sa: सोऽहमेवं चरिष्यामि प्रीतिरत्र हि मे सदा। न च मां वेत्स्यते कश्चित् तोषयिष्ये च पार्थिवम्॥१३
en: Thus shall I pass my days; there is always a delight for me in this work, and no one shall recognize me and moreover I will entertain the monarch.

sa: दुःशासन: प्रातिलोम्यान्निनाय सभामध्ये श्वशुराणां च कृष्णाम्। सा तत्र नीता करुणं व्यपेक्ष्य नान्यं क्षत्तु थमवाप किंचित्॥
en: Dushasana brought Krishna by force into the council chamber where there were her fathers-in-law at the time. Brought there she expected kind treatment, but she found there no protector save Vidura.

sa: द्रोण उवाच यथा रथस्य निर्घोषो यथा मेघ उदीर्यते। कम्पते च यथा भूमि षोऽन्यः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Drona said From the rattle of the car, from the way in which the clouds have appeared, and in which the earth shakes he is none other than Savyasachin.

sa: यथा वाहं नातिचरे कथंचित् पतीन् महार्हान् मनसापि जातु। तेनाद्य सत्येन वशीकृतं त्वां द्रष्टास्मि पाथैः परिकृष्यमाणम्॥
en: As I have never proved false even in my mind to my worthy husbands, so by that merit I shall see you today vanquished and dragged by the sons of Pritha.

sa: परिवेष्टनमेतेषां क्षिप्रं चैव व्यपानुदा सोऽपहृत्य महार्हाणि धनूंषि पृथुवक्षसाम्। परिवेष्टनपत्राणि विमुच्य समुपानयत्॥ तथा संनहनान्येषां परिमुच्य समन्ततः।
en: Cut off soon the wrappers of all these. Cutting off the covering and the ropes with which they were tied on all sides he brought those valuable bows having spacious rods.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं समृद्धमसमृद्धं तपो भवति केवलम्। सनत्सुजात् तद् ब्रूहि यथा विद्याम तद् वयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How can asceticism which is ever the same be successful now and unsuccessful at another time. O Sanat-Sujata, tell us this that we two may know it.

sa: अविद्या वै महत्यस्ति यामिमां संश्रिताः प्रजाः। तव स्याद् यदि सद्वृत्तं तेन मे त्वं प्रियो भवेः॥
en: Great is the ignorance in this world in which all living creatures have taken refuge; if your habits life be praise worthy, then will you win my esteem by that means,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा स गन्धर्ववरोपमो युवा विराटराज्ञा मुदितेन पूजितः। न चैनमन्येऽपि विदुः कथंचन प्रियाभिरामं विचरन्तमन्तरा॥
en: Vaishampayana said That youthful one resembling the chief of the Gandharvas was thus honoured by the delighted king of Virata, and no one recognized him conducting himself agreeably in the city.

sa: नैव कुन्तीसुतः पार्थो नैव कृष्णो जनार्दनः। न हया न रथो राजन् दृश्यन्ते स्म शरैश्चिताः॥
en: Covered with those shafts, neither the son of Kunti, namely Partha, nor Krishna the assuager of the grief of men, nor horses nor chariots, O monarch, could be seen.

sa: तथैव भीमसेनोऽपि राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः। सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च भारत।॥ तावकांस्तव पुत्रांश्च सहितान् सर्वराजभिः। द्रावयामासुराजौ ते त्रिदशा दानवानिव॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Bhimasena, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, Satyaki, Chekitana, the sons of Draupadi, backed by all the kings, chastised your troops and your sons, as the celestials did the Danavas.

sa: समुद्यतां तां यमदण्डकल्पां दृष्ट्वा गदां ते कुरवः समन्तात्। विहाय सर्वे तव पुत्रमुग्रं पातं गदायाः परिहर्तुकामाः॥
en: Beholding that mace, resembling the mace of Death himself, thus raised overhead (by Bhishma), every one of the Kuru warriors, eager to avoid its fall, deserting the van of your son,

sa: श्रुतं मे कर्ण भीष्मस्य द्वेषात् किल न योत्स्यसे। अस्मान् वरय राधेय यावद् भीष्मो न हन्यते॥
en: "O Karna, I have heard that from the hatred you bear for Bhishma you will not fight. O son of Radha, come to our side, so long Bhishma is not killed.

sa: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान् यः स मे प्रियः।।१७।
en: He is dear to Me who has no joy and no aversion, who neither grieves nor desire, who renounces both good and evil and who is full of faith in Me.

sa: येन क्षयं न गच्छन्ति दिवि तारागणा इव। पुनः पुनर्न मृष्यामि हतं सैन्यं तु पाण्डवैः।
en: In consequences of which they suffer no reduction, like the stars in the firmament? I can not bear the repeated slaughter of my warriors by the sons of Pandu.

sa: किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा॥ येषामर्थे काक्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।
